lintIssues.message: Program must start with a standalone % line.
Program must end with a standalone % line.
Cancel family conflict on the same block — split G40/G49/G80/G69/G50 cancels into separate blocks.
Axis motion before any unit mode (G20/G21) — select inch or metric units first.
Axis motion before any feed mode (G93/G94/G95) — select inverse-time, per-minute, or per-rev feed mode first.
G0 rapid while tool length compensation (G43) is still active — cancel with G49 before rapid moves.
M5 while tool length compensation (G43) is still active — cancel with G49 when stopping the spindle.
Program ends with tool length compensation (G43) still active — cancel with G49 before end.
